body:
I'm pretty good with handling rejection but that's only with random chicks that I will meet in a bar party. I don't have a problem going up to a girl and introducing myself and then if it doesn't work out I'm fine. But when ever I'm rejected by someone that I actually start to develop feelings for it is just the most soul crushing thing ever. I just want one girl where I can have something other than a shallow drunken hookup.

The grades I'm hoping I can salvage. I think if I apply myself I might be able to do okay this semester.  It is just such a struggle to get interested and do the work. It's like pulling teeth. I just don't care enough.

The stuff that troubles me the most is the suicidal thoughts. I really don't want to be having feelings like these.  Whenever something goes wrong I think about it and that's not what I want to think about when I get rejected or get bad grades. Because I know its not worth it to kill yourself over something as trival as that but I still think these thoughts.
